LanguageData.RAWC_Gun_PPX_Eleven_Compact.description: A printed spacer handgun, famous for being easy to produce, use, and conceal. This version is chambered for a large-bore cartridge for great stopping power.
LanguageData.RAWC_Gun_PPX_Four_Tactical.label: PPX 4.4 Tactical
LanguageData.RAWC_Gun_PPX_Four_Tactical.description: A full-size printed spacer handgun. Designed as a duty sidearm, it is large and potent, with an extended barrel, a lengthened grip, higher-capacity magazines, and modular attachment points. This version is chambered for a small, high-velocity cartridge.

This version is chambered for a large, high-power cartridge.
LanguageData.RAWC_Gun_PRX_Eleven.label: PRX 11
LanguageData.RAWC_Gun_PRX_Eleven.description: A printed spacer revolver. With its timeless double-action operation, it can tolerate neglect and ammunition failures without compromising its reliability or performance. It fires a large, high-power cartridge.

LanguageData.RAWC_Gun_PRX_Eleven.tools.1.label: muzzle

LanguageData.RAWC_Gun_RX_Six.label: RX 6.3
LanguageData.RAWC_Gun_RX_Six.description: A printed spacer assault rifle. Designed by merging and refining the features of its most successful contemporaries, it combines modularity, ruggedness, and ease of production into an ergonomic platform that has been produced and fielded across all of human space.

LanguageData.RAWC_Gun_RBX_Eight.tools.0.label: stock
LanguageData.RAWC_Gun_RBX_Eight.tools.1.label: barrel
LanguageData.RAWC_Gun_RTX_Six.label: RTX 6.3
LanguageData.RAWC_Gun_RTX_Six.description: A printed spacer bolt-action takedown rifle. It is designed to break down into three components and can be reassembled in seconds by a trained operator. Its simple and reliable action, portability, range, and accuracy have made it popular with away crews, hunters, and frontiersmen.
